text:
Leah: quick sync  field asks for a 'commit accelerator coupon' we can publish in marketplace to nudge renewals to convert to reserved capacity. Need rules so coupons don't circumvent commit sizing or escape SLAs.

Tomas: love the idea. thoughts: coupons should only apply at renewal (not mid-term) and only when converting from a marketplace virtual SKU to a private/reserved contract. That keeps discoverability but controls economics.

Yara: agree. also propose a staggered renewal window: 30/60/90 day offers with decreasing coupon value (e.g., 12%/8%/4%) to drive early conversions. Include an "accelerator cap" so total discount doesn't exceed negotiated partner margin.

Quentin: ops concern: how do we honor coupon without marketplace-native discounting? We should issue an off-invoice credit applied when we create the private PO. Flow: marketplace renewal triggers a conversion task -> partner_ops issues coupon credit on private contract.

Leah: good. security/compliance note: any coupon that incentivizes moving to private must not require escrow or KMS on marketplace. If customer needs KMS/escrow, conversion still allowed but initial purchase must be private.

OpsBot: FYI: marketplace APIs don't support deferred coupons. See internal ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-7012

Tomas: telemetry: emit `renewal_accel_signal(customer, sku, days_until_renewal, pct_util)` when customer is >70% util and renewal <90d. That surfaces candidates for coupons.

Yara: partner overlay: allow SI to register a co-fund code that reduces the net price for the first renewal only. This is an off-invoice co-fund tracked in Partner Portal. Need partner opt-in during listing.

Quentin: legal must approve coupon T&Cs: coupon only applies at conversion to reserved capacity within X days of renewal, non-transferrable, subject to capacity availability. Also include clause that marketplace listing may be delisted if partner terms conflict. I'll ping Legal.

Leah: rollout plan: 1) pilot with 3 strategic SI partners, small-cap (<=$150k) deals only. 2) telemetry + playbook + partner opt-in checkbox. 3) marketing co-announce window: 2 weeks prep for pilot assets and partner approvals.

Tomas: failure modes: if partner doesn't opt-in or marketplace quota blocks the virtual SKU, fall back to private-only conversion (no coupon). Notify seller 48h before fallback.

Yara: metric targets for pilot: conversion lift >=20% inside 60d, and net new reserved ARR >= $500k in quarter. We'll instrument Console to track.

Leah: action items: Tomas -> telemetry & sample alert payload (due Tue). Quentin -> legal clause draft + partner opt-in language (due Fri). Yara -> pilot partner shortlist + marketing brief (due Wed). I'll own the PR for listing checkbox and the conversion workflow.

Quentin: looping Legal now :email:
